instructions: The marks are indicated in the right-hand margin.
There are NINE questions in this paper.

questions.text:
Give antonyms of the following words by adding suitable negative prefixes :
(i) Consistent
(ii) Nutrition
(iii) Legible
(iv) Appropriate

Fill in the blanks with suitable tense forms of the verbs given in brackets :
Stephen Hawking is one of the most brilliant theoretical physicists. He ______ (be) also a popular writer. His first book, A Brief History of Time ______ (publish) in 1988 and ______ (become) an international best seller. In it, he ______ (explain) about the birth and death of the universe to the lay person.

Choose the correct form of verb that agrees with the subject :
(i) The Minister, together with his wife, ______ (greets, greet) the press cordially.
(ii) The players, as well as the captain, ______ (want, wants) to win.
(iii) Neither the teacher nor the students ______ (seem, seems) to understand this assignment.
(iv) One of my teachers ______ (have, has) written a letter of recommendation for me.

Make the passive forms of the following sentences :
(i) God loves all.
(ii) David painted the wall beautifully.

Fill in the blanks with the appropriate article :
(i) Shweta studies in ______ European University.
(ii) This is ______ boy who killed ______ snake.
(iii) Venika eats ______ egg everyday.

Make sentences with the given phrases :
(i) Far and near
(ii) Call off

Give homonyms of the following :
(i) Berth
(ii) Site
(iii) Bite
(iv) Fare

Fill in the blanks with appropriate prepositions :
(i) Sanjay gets up ______ five o'clock in the morning.
(ii) I ran after him and caught him ______ the arm.

Give the superlatives of the given adjectives :
(i) Rich
(ii) Pretty
(iii) Old
(iv) Beautiful

Rewrite the following sentences into reported speech :
(i) Anne says, "She loves me."
(ii) "Finish the work in an hour," said my teacher.

Write in not more than 250 words on any one of the following :
(a) The use and abuse of cell phone
(b) Advertisement that have impelled me to buy things

Write a note on any one of the following :
(a) Television
(b) Cyber crime
Give eight recommendations for how to save electricity.
Electronic waste is a major problem in most of the countries since it has become a major cause for different diseases. Write an essay not exceeding 300 words on health effects of electronic wastes.

sections.section_title: Q.6 Write notes on any two of the following :

questions.text: Auxiliary verb
Bilabial nasal
Morpheme
Write a covering letter, forwarding your CV to the head of a firm, for any entry level position.
For non-English speakers everywhere, English has become a common tongue. Support this statement from your own experience.
Write a letter to the editor of a newspaper expressing your concern about the increase in the number of road accidents.
